autism_enjoyer_08: On Day 4 Bastian Enjoyer took a post at R-F23 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He laughs at exactly the wrong moments, and the men liked him for it.

A shell burst over R-F23 and threw Bastian Enjoyer into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Bastian Enjoyer raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F23. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 has been won. Bastian Enjoyer listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

There were too few medics and too many wounded. Bastian Enjoyer waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

There was never a bed for Bastian Enjoyer, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F23 on his own feet. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Bastian Enjoyer waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Bastian Enjoyer has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Bastian Enjoyer dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Anselm Alexj coming out. It was over in seconds. (@alexj.558) The flare went up just as Bastian Enjoyer reached the Concord parapet. Bastian Enjoyer jumped down first. Karel Adauto was the man waiting there, and Karel Adauto fell. (@santiago.g.adauto) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-F23 changed before the cheering ended. Bastian Enjoyer shouldered another load. A letter from home reached Bastian Enjoyer before dusk. Bastian Enjoyer read it twice and slept a little easier.
cal.cbr: Leopold Cbr arrived at Q-F16 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
damiancarrillo2003: Day 9. The corporal put Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
deionmurillo: Bastian Deionmurillo arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a child's drawing of a horse and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

The Hegemony sentry, Ulrich Yoye, shouted once. Bastian Deionmurillo silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@yoye501) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Bastian Deionmurillo hit Zeno Illegalxeno with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@illegalxeno9) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Bastian Deionmurillo was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Bastian Deionmurillo looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
democracy_man2144: Day 9. The corporal put Dorian Man beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Dorian Man helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
dratlaix: Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix tried to describe the smell of Marrow Fen and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. The machine gunners took Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix in on a busy morning in R-S2. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix wrote down the news without trying to explain it. A letter from home reached Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix before dusk. Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix read it twice and slept a little easier.
guapoo007_: Dorian "Mole" Guapoo arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Water rose to the second step of the dugout. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo moved a lucky button to the highest shelf and sat beside it like a guard. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at S-F2 changed before the cheering ended. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo shouldered another load.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F2. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Leopold "Saint" Hop of the Concord (@its.hop_). A letter from home reached Dorian "Mole" Guapoo before dusk. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Mole" Guapoo is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. Dorian "Mole" Guapoo walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
jeremythomas52: Norbert Jeremythomas, a blacksmith from Kesselby, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in U-F15. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
lucas.b.garbo: Cyril "Bones" Garbo walked into S-C9 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Cyril "Bones" Garbo heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
magnusmadsen37: At the depot, Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen had practised answering to his name. At R-F18, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate. Verdel Ridge is lost. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
At Lantern Hill, Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord and Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen's hands still remember being a tailor's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.

A patient at the aid post asked Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Ulrich Asher and Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at Hill 304, Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen was promoted to Lance Corporal.
The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen asks about each detail while changing the dressing.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen across the shin at R-F18. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr of the Concord (@kelvincornbread).

Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
manmc.maann: At the depot, Florian Maann had practised answering to his name. At S-S5, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A report called the trench satisfactory. Florian Maann invited the author to spend a night in it before signing. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Maann. Florian Maann read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Florian Maann went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Albin Chloe was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@chloe.g.t) Florian Maann jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Felix "Parson" Brendanm. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@brendanm_4) The Hegemony raiders came over at S-S5 in the middle of the night. Florian Maann met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Yann Somosmagios of the Hegemony (@somosmagios.bo).
Bastian "Mud" Maann had heard about Florian Maann's courage. At S-S5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
marquis_de_lafayette1757_1834: Nobody saw Matthias Lafayette arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F12, and a quiet stretcher bearer under it.
One of the first hundred, Matthias Lafayette was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Matthias Lafayette shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Matthias Lafayette folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Matthias Lafayette read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Matthias Lafayette put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.

Valentin Zle and Matthias Lafayette split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. A letter from home reached Matthias Lafayette before dusk. Matthias Lafayette read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Matthias Lafayette stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Matthias Lafayette won a pocket watch that does not work at cards from a lance corporal in S-F12. The lance corporal wants a rematch.

Rematch. Matthias Lafayette lost everything he won, plus a dented harmonica. The whole dugout watched. A letter from home reached Matthias Lafayette before dusk. Matthias Lafayette read it twice and slept a little easier.
Valentin Zle and Matthias Lafayette cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.

Matthias Lafayette was hit through the chest at S-F12. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak). Matthias Lafayette stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F12. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak).

Nils Lafayette came to the front because his cousin Matthias Lafayette never came home. He carries a dented harmonica. Nils Lafayette's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Nils Lafayette heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
nicholasberthelotte: The draft reached R-R15 on Day 9. Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
projectpuffypenguin: Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy came up on Day 3 carrying news from Brennmoor. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
The trench wall shook against Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.

Yann Vee wrote a letter for Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's mother, because Saint could not find the words. Saint signed it. A letter from home reached Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy before dusk. Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F4 and grazed Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony (@brendanm_4).
The medics cleaned Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F4.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's ear at S-F4 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer of the Hegemony (@w0lfer2210).

Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
r.raphoto: They issued Lucien Raphoto a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a frozen apple in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Lucien Raphoto, volunteer number 60, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Lucien Raphoto wrote a list of things to buy on leave. It began with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Lucien Raphoto polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Otto Valiantlyval pulled Lucien Raphoto out of a flooded shell hole at the Brickworks. Neither of them has mentioned it since. Both of them remember. Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Lucien Raphoto could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Lucien Raphoto's hands still remember being a medical student's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Lucien Raphoto began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
Nobody else in S-F13 wanted the stripes. Lucien Raphoto said yes. Lance Corporal. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Lucien Raphoto watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The reply to Lucien Raphoto's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Lucien Raphoto asked the dugout for advice on the next move. Three men disagreed so fiercely that a second board had to be drawn.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Lucien Raphoto shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Otto Carlingiti, was badly wounded.
Lucien Raphoto received a letter announcing checkmate. The dugout insists the position was copied incorrectly. He has written back asking for another game.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F13. Lucien Raphoto was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Walter Mat of the Hegemony (@civo_mat).

The papers connected Otto Raphoto to Lucien Raphoto. The men took longer to learn Otto Raphoto's own habits, but they made the effort. The first hundred were recognised, and Otto Raphoto was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.
tylerlockadoodle: Karel Tylerlockado told the sergeant he was a blacksmith. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Karel Tylerlockado kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
wtz.lft: Jakub Lft walked into S-R12 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Jakub Lft helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
